title: Lacatski's books describe UFOs as consciousness puzzles

tellings.quote: if you read his book uh new insights and I think his other book as well he talks about UFOs as puzzles as like almost consciousness puzzles.

plain: In his book New Insights, and perhaps in his other book too, a former US defense intelligence official named James Lacatski describes UFOs as puzzles, almost puzzles of consciousness. Michels says this himself from his own reading and does not point to a passage. Read this way, the phenomenon would have as much to do with the mind as with machines.
